name: BetterHusk
subtitle: Android apps and games on your iPhone — Husk, plus the fixes upstream hasn't merged.
description: The official source for BetterHusk, a community fork of Leviidev's Husk. Add it to SideStore, AltStore or another sideloader to install BetterHusk and get its updates. BetterHusk installs next to Husk (com.betterhusk.app), it does not replace it.

apps.name: BetterHusk
apps.subtitle: Android apps and PS4 games on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: BetterHusk is a fork of Husk that tracks upstream and additionally ships fixes upstream has not merged yet: a Java sensor-manager API for Unity games, Godot 4.6/4.7 file and directory handlers, V8 --jitless for Cocos Creator games, manifest-based base-APK selection for split bundles, dynamic RemotePairing port discovery for built-in JIT, and a W^X-safe executable-memory path for TrollStore devices.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BetterHusk uses the local network to pair with this iPhone for JIT, without a computer.

news.title: BetterHusk is here
news.caption: A fork of Husk that ships upstream's unmerged fixes. First IPA lands via the Build BetterHusk IPA workflow.
